manifest.claim_text: The magnetically induced E-field solver reproduces the closed-form (Sarvas / Heller-van Hulsteyn) solution for a spherically symmetric conductor, validated independently of any neural-response model.
manifest.falsified_by: relative error above tolerance against the closed form, or a mesh-refinement study that does not converge at the advertised order
manifest.consequence_if_failed: The induced-field solver may not be used for TMS E-field prediction, target engagement or pose ranking; every downstream induction-dependent claim is suspended (N3 does not cover this: it validates conduction, not induction).
non_goals: These checks establish code correctness only. Numerical correctness is necessary, never sufficient: agreement with recorded signals is stronger, held-out perturbation stronger still (thesis §0.2).

known_uninformative_fields.git_dirty_whole_tree: a whole-tree dirty flag always reads dirty during a run, because the run writes tracked output (reports/training/*.log, *.jsonl). It cannot distinguish modified source from a run writing its own log, so it is not recorded here and must not be gated on. Use source_dirty_paths.
